title: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers
summary: We prove that the complete double-dimer loop ensemble for the Temperleyan square lattice in the upper half-plane converges to nested CLE 4 . The convergence holds along the full mesh limit and matches every macroscopic loop as an unparametrized curve. This resolves the half-plane Temperleyan form of the double-dimer CLE 4 scaling-limit conjecture.
family_title: The double-dimer loop ensemble converges to CLE 4
